programs.title: Emily
programs.desc: Emily Brontë struggles within the confines of her life, yearning for artistic and personal freedom. She finds romance before writing her seminal novel, "Wuthering Heights.".

programs.title: Finally Caught
programs.desc: Shele Danishefsky Covlin, a successful finance executive in New York, was initially thought to have died accidentally in her bathtub in December 2009. However, suspicions about her estranged husband, Roderick Covlin, started surfacing and led to her body being exhumed, revealing she had been strangled. Roderick, who had tried to access Shele's estate and even plotted to frame their 9 year old daughter for the murder, became the prime suspect.

programs.title: Influenced to Kill
programs.desc: Popular lifestyle influencer Amanda Jane mysteriously vanishes after staying at a struggling inn. Suspicious of foul play, an employee looks into Amanda's disappearance, not realizing that she's at risk of becoming the next victim.

programs.title: Trapped in the Spotlight
programs.desc: A psychotic music producer kidnaps a cancelled R&B singer and her former co-star 15 years after they broke up. With their lives and legacies on the line, the estranged duo must face the demons from their past to make it out alive.

programs.title: Tall, Dark and Dangerous
programs.desc: As Valentine's Day approaches, a successful real estate attorney finds her seemingly perfect match on a dating app. However, she soon realizes that the man is an impostor who stole the identity of his former roommate to insert himself into her life.

programs.title: The Boy That Never Was
programs.desc: Throwing Robin off the trail, Harry convinces her that he now knows she was right, seeing Dillon was all in his head.
